name: Centrifuge
description: Centrifuge is a platform for tokenizing real-world assets such as Treasury funds, private credit and structured credit. Asset managers issue pool tokens on Ethereum and other networks; investors onboard with each manager (KYC and jurisdiction checks), and only approved wallets on a pool's on-chain memberlist can invest or hold the tokens.
description_zh: Centrifuge 是一个将现实世界资产（如国债基金、私人信贷和结构化信贷）代币化的平台。资产管理人在以太坊等网络上发行资金池代币；投资者需分别通过各管理人的开户流程（KYC 和司法管辖区检查），只有列入资金池链上成员名单的钱包才能投资或持有代币。
chains: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Plume
repo_status: open (monorepo for Centrifuge frontends; last push 2025-10-01, may lag the current app)

geo_feature.scope: Per pool: managers apply KYC/AML and jurisdiction screening and the app restricts access where a pool requires it; flagship funds are non-US offerings. Country lists are set per pool and not published centrally.

kyc.scope: Per pool: KYC/AML with the asset manager, then the wallet is added to the pool's on-chain memberlist (separately on each network) before it can invest or hold tokens.

tos.us_scope: set per pool; flagship funds are non-US offerings
tos.restricted: Services may be unavailable in some jurisdictions or limited to sophisticated, accredited or qualified investors

notes: The frontend is open source (centrifuge/apps); investing requires the manager's approval on the pool's on-chain memberlist.
